ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Topics on Wireless Networks. Prerequisite: CS 438 or equivalent. Topics: wireless communication basics, access technologies, medium access control, naming and addressing, routing and forwarding, wireless transport, mobility support and management, security, and power management. We will examine and discuss challenges and solutions to these problems in the contexts of 2/3G cellular networks, wireless LANs, ad-hoc networks, and mesh networks.
